Game Overview

In My Sweet Candy Outfits, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner fashionista in My Sweet Candy Outfits. Style the Rainbow high girls with candy-themed ensembles for their weekend bash. Mix vibrant colors and patterns using simple point-and-click controls. Experiment with endless wardrobe choices to design fabulously sweet looks, all set against a playful and colorful backdrop.
